title: Lookup in an Appended List
statement: Let $l_1$ and $l_2$ be lists of elements of a type $\alpha$, and let $i,j$ be natural numbers. If $i=|l_1|+j$, $j<|l_2|$, and $i<|l_1\mathbin{++}l_2|$, then the entry at index $i$ of the concatenated list is the entry at index $j$ of $l_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $j$ is less than the length of $l_2$
$i$ is less than the length of the concatenation
